descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S11 Task states on every task surface: Complete -> Reopen -> Complete, Complete then Delete, Delete, on Post-Round, the Encounter tab and both task lists — each tap is its own kind of event

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately) (UAT OAT-06 Test 7; UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; UAT TC-24; TFA-94514 AC 2)
  • U15 Usage analytics rows carry no patient content (no name, MRN, room, diagnosis, task text or note text), so rows that outlive a deleted patient do not break the 36 h retention claim or TC-24's hard del … (UAT 3.6; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fresh physician; the Hospital patient has six open tasks and the Nursing Home resident one; T0 recorded

When Hospital Post-Round: task A Complete, Reopen, Complete; task B Complete then Delete; task C Delete. Hospital Encounter tab: task E Complete, task F Delete. Hospital task list for all patients (/rounding/tasks): Complete task G, and record whether it offers a delete. …

Then Every Complete tap is a task_completed row and every Delete tap a task_deleted row, never mixed; a Reopen is not a row; each row carries its surface's careSetting (hospital for Post-Round, the Encounter tab and /rounding/tasks, nursing_home for /snf/tasks) and the right patientId. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-06 Test 7 + TC-24 'separate actions, each logged separately': judged = no Complete logged as a delete or the reverse, each row against the right chart and care setting on every surface. The exact counts for the reopen and the complete-then-delete paths are recorded, not judged, until Q6 is answered. U15: serialised rows mustNotContain any task text or patient name

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
